## ICONIC Release Intent

Describe exactly what changed, which ICONIC property it affects, and the intended visitor outcome.

## UI Quality Gate — REQUIRED

- [ ] Homepage animation remains a clean visual canvas with NO interface words/CTAs layered over it.
- [ ] Every modified card uses the exact approved image/design for its destination property.
- [ ] No stock, placeholder, recycled, cross-property or stale creative was introduced.
- [ ] Property identities remain distinct; the platform has not flattened them into one generic template.
- [ ] Desktop visual QA completed.
- [ ] Mobile visual QA completed.
- [ ] Links, forms, access routes and merch routes tested.
- [ ] `npm run validate:ui` passes.
- [ ] TypeScript passes.
- [ ] Production build passes.
- [ ] Vercel preview reviewed before merge.

## Asset Mapping

List every new or changed visual and its source-of-truth route/asset.

## Vercel Preview

Paste preview URL and QA notes.

## Rollback

Identify the last known-good commit/deployment or describe the revert path.
